content: Taŋgo ande kupe baklelok mayekina

Taŋgo ande ina sinamŋge kupe baklelok mayok kina. Mara mindek nane afu taŋgo ta sukuŋga taŋgo pino ndametiŋ yabaŋniŋgam tuku kusem wande malaŋga ande nyunu Maditak tugum taŋge palmbinu. Ait ande Petrus nale Yohanus ndoŋ Kuate yabaŋam tuku ait ki kanum 3 mbolŋge nale kusem wande ta mbol kinaik. Kinaik le nane afu maŋ taŋgo ta sukuŋga pro taŋge pilnaig.
Kile Petrus nale kusem wande sinam kambim bafunaik le taŋgo ta nale kaŋgerka agaŋ inum tuwaik ŋga nale yabaŋnikina.
Yabaŋnikina le Petrus nale nu fumble timba sanaik: Ne sile kaŋgerka ŋginaik.
Taŋakinaik le nu idusna agaŋ ande ye sam tuku sayade ŋga idusmba nu nale kaŋger tidiŋga minna le
Petrus nu ndek sana: Ye gol silwa ndametiŋ kugatok ta ye ne agaŋ ande tanmbimŋgit. Ne Nasaretnu taŋgo Yesus Kristus tuku saŋgri mbolŋge ne tiŋga lika ŋgina.
Taŋakina sulumba nu taŋgo ta tuku wai ndinam biymba te-duŋgina le rakukadu kupe mbain turmba saŋgri tiŋgina.
Taŋana le nu pitik ndo pastiŋga nale ndoŋ kusem wandek sinam kumba gare-gareka Kuate tuku nyu te-duŋga nu kumbaŋge pate-pateŋga kina.
Nu kumbaŋge Kuate tuku nyu te-duŋgina le taŋgo pino nu kaŋgermba kila pilmba sakinaig:
i ... Kusem wande malaŋga Maditak tugumŋge ndametiŋ yabaŋkate taŋgo ta not ŋginaig. Taŋamba nane pirerek purka wamdus te-sulumba minnaig.
Taŋgo ta Petrus le Yohanus bigmba nane ma ande nyunu Solomon tuku kawaŋ pronaig le nane gudommba pinder-pindermba pro taŋgo ta kaŋgermba pirerek purka wai makemba minnaig le

Petrus nu wam ta kaŋgermba nane saniŋgina: Israel mbal, ndaŋam saka tane pro wam te tuku pirerek purka am goka sine kaŋger tidiŋgade. Sile taŋgo magenu sikile saŋgrimbi taŋgo te wakeiwanu ŋga idusde e? Taŋamba kuga.

Abraham Isak Yakob siŋgine mbuŋ ŋakmba tuku Mbara nu nuŋe piro taŋgo Yesus tuku nyu mbol kuwa ŋga nu wam te kate. Tane Yesus tumba gafman tuku wai mbolŋge pilnaig le Pilatus nu Yesus paskam tuku sakina ta tane saŋgri maramba mbulnaig.
Kuate tuku taŋgo purfeŋnu ta tane mbulmba taŋgo balewanu taŋgo paska te-mayokam tuku Pilatus sanaig.
Tane abo tugu miro balenaig. Tane balenaig ta Kuate nu te-tina le tiŋgina le sile Yohanus ndoŋ kaŋgerkeŋ.
Tane taŋgo kaŋgerde te sile Yesus tuku saŋgri tomba tiŋga taŋgo te kupe te-tiwe tukik le tane ŋakmba am mbolŋge nu mayekat.
Yiŋe tira kame, tane gabat kame ndoŋ Yesus mbolŋge wam ŋayonaig ta tane nu tuku tugu katese ndamba taŋanaig ta ye kila.
Kuate nu o buk nuŋe tuan taŋgo kame tuku miŋge mbolŋge nuŋe madina taŋgo rar tam tuku sakinaig ta alonu Yesus mbolŋge kumuŋgina.
Ta tuku taŋgine maŋau ŋaigonu kusreka ŋgamuŋgal biye mbilap le Kuate nu tane tuku une ŋakmba sauke sulumba tane wamdus bul sertiŋguwa le gare ŋak minamŋgaig.
Nu Yesus kukulwa le tane tugum prowamŋgat. Nu o buk tane muskil kile-tidiŋge tiŋgam tuku nu pilna.
Kile nu samba mbolŋge minmba Kuate nu wam ŋakmba kile-tidiŋguwa le wam tugusek ndo minam tuku ait tairŋga minit. O buk Kuate nu nuŋe tuan taŋgo kame tuku miŋge mbolŋge ait ta tuku sakina.
Moses nu teŋenmba sakina.

content.text: Suŋgo Kuate nuŋe pasa te-mayokam tuku ye tuan taŋgo pilna taŋamba ndo nu sine Israel ŋgamukŋge tuan taŋgo ande palmbimŋgat. Tane nu tuku pasa ŋakmba ise tiwap.
Ande nu nu tuku pasa talawa ta Kuateŋge nuŋe mbal ŋgamukŋge paska tumba kasomŋge pilwa le nu ŋgisikamŋgat. Lo 18.15-19

content: Moses nu taŋamba sakina.
Kuate tuku tuan taŋgo Samuel tuan taŋgo afu nu ŋgumnemŋge mayok kinaig ta nane ŋakmba ait te mbolŋge wam prowam tuku sake likinaig.

Tane Kuate tuku tuan taŋgo kame tuku mbuŋ. Kuate nu pasa saŋgrinu taŋgine mbuŋ niŋmba Abraham ndoŋ wamdus ulendika siŋka son pasa sakina ta tane tuku turmba sakina. Nu teŋenmba Abraham sana. Ne tuku mbuŋ kat naŋe mbolŋge kilke tugu ŋakmba mbolŋge ye wam mayenu kamŋgit ŋgina.
Kuate nu nuŋe piro taŋgo te-tina sulumba sine Israel mbal maŋau ŋaigonu kusreka gare maŋau mbolŋge minbe ŋga nu Yesus kukulna le amboŋga sine tugum prona ŋga saniŋgina.
